lines.zh: 巫师缓步走来，袍子拖地
lines.en: The Sorcerer comes slowly, robe dragging.
His dark blade hangs by his hand.

lines.zh: 他的靴子踩碎了地上的骨头
lines.en: His boots crush bone underfoot.

lines.zh: 每一步都很稳，毫无迟疑
lines.en: Every step is certain.

lines.zh: 他的皮甲在暗中没有反光
lines.en: His leather armour gives no glint.
He rounds a fire and walks on.
His hem lifts a little dust.
He stops only when close.
He shifts the sword to his other hand.
His breathing shows no rise or fall.
The Sorcerer stands, sword point down.
He taps the hilt with a knuckle.
His face is unreadable under the hood.

lines.zh: 他的手指在空气里画了一下
lines.en: A finger draws in the air.

lines.zh: 地上浮起一个暗红的圈
lines.en: A dull red circle surfaces on the ground.
Nothing is inside it.
He lowers his hand slowly.
The circle fades.

lines.zh: 他把剑插在地上，扶了一下
lines.en: He rests the sword point in the ground.
His shoulders do not move.

lines.zh: 风掀起他的袍角，又落下
lines.en: The wind lifts his hem and drops it.
His breathing is nearly absent.
Then he lifts his head.
A red glint shows under the hood.
He mutters a few words.
A smell of scorch enters the air.
The Sorcerer turns his face to you.
The look from under the hood weighs on you.
He lifts the sword point off the ground.
He sizes you up, briefly.
He points a finger at you.

lines.zh: 他的指下浮起一点暗红
lines.en: A dull red spot forms under it.
He seems to calculate your worth.
He shakes his head, unimpressed.
He raises the sword to his chest.
He backs half a step, letting you speak.
His patience is very limited.
He steps one pace closer.

lines.zh: 巫师晃了一下，袍子乱了些
lines.en: The Sorcerer sways; his robe is disordered.
He steps back, blade still up.

lines.zh: 红圈在他脚下闪了一下
lines.en: A red circle flickers at his feet.

lines.zh: 他低声念了一句，像在骂人
lines.en: He mutters something like a curse.
His leather armour splits.
He sets his hood straight.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸第一次有了起伏
lines.en: For the first time his breathing shows.
He retreats and lifts a hand.
The circles light again.
His look is colder than before.

lines.zh: 巫师看了一眼你手上的东西
lines.en: The Sorcerer glances at what you hold.

lines.zh: 他伸出两根手指夹过来
lines.en: Two fingers take it from you.
He holds it against the red circle.
He drops it into the circle.
Smoke rises from the circle.
The thing is gone in an instant.

lines.zh: 食物在他眼里不值一看
lines.en: Food is not worth a glance to him.
He shakes his head; put it away.

lines.zh: 他更在意你身上的装备
lines.en: Your gear interests him far more.
He extends an open palm.

lines.zh: 你撞上巫师，他纹丝不动
lines.en: You hit the Sorcerer; he does not move.
His blade bars the way.

lines.zh: 你被剑脊推得退了半步
lines.en: The flat of the blade pushes you back.
He glances at his hem.
He turns aside one step.

lines.zh: 红圈在碰撞处亮了一下
lines.en: A red circle flares at the contact.
He withdraws and raises the blade.
His breathing does not change.
He seems not to care.
But he has noted where you stood.
Two figures stand side by side.

lines.zh: 它们的袍子垂到同一处地面
lines.en: Their robes reach the same patch of ground.
They trade a gesture.
Two red circles rise on the ground.
The circles overlap.
They chant low together.
The smell of scorch doubles.

lines.zh: 他们的剑尖指向同一个方向
lines.en: Their blades point the same way.
The circles slowly widen.
Then they go out together.

lines.zh: 巫师抬手把东西提起来
lines.en: The Sorcerer lifts the item with a gesture.
It floats above his palm.
He turns it over to look.
What he does not want, he grinds to powder.

lines.zh: 他把东西收进袍子的内袋
lines.en: He stows it in an inner pocket.
He burns it to ash on a whim.
His movements are very slow.
He looks at the ash, then at you.
What is useful, he keeps.
Then his hand comes up again.
The Sorcerer raises the blade.
The red circle widens under you.
He points a hand at the sky.
A low tone sounds in the air.
The circle turns bright.
He murmurs a phrase.
The ground begins to tremble.

lines.zh: 他把兜帽往后推了一点
lines.en: He pushes the hood back a little.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛露出来了，红得发暗
lines.en: His eyes show, dark red.

lines.zh: 他退开一步，把红圈留在原地
lines.en: He steps back, leaving the circle.
His hand holds in the air.
The blade tip turns your way.
A thread of smoke rises from the circle.
He presses the blade down.
The trembling deepens.
He is ready.
A count runs behind his eyes.
His lips barely move.

lines.zh: 巫师在你周围画了第二个圈
lines.en: The Sorcerer draws a second circle.
Two circles bracket you.
He paces the outer ring.
His blade stays on you.
He points once more.

lines.zh: 红圈里冒出的烟更浓了
lines.en: Smoke thickens from the circles.
He is working out the blast radius.
You step back; the circle follows.
He starts a count in his head.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸依旧没有起伏
lines.en: His breathing still shows nothing.
He sets the blade back in the ground.

lines.zh: 空出来的那只手抬高了
lines.en: The freed hand rises.
The circles turn blinding.
He has retreated to a safe distance.

lines.zh: 他看着你，像看一个靶子
lines.en: He looks at you as at a target.
A finger curls.
The air draws tight.
He finishes the last word.
Then he drops his hand.
He waits outside the ring for the result.
The Sorcerer cuts across.
The edge carries a dull red sheen.
A boot catches your knee.
An elbow drives into your chest.

lines.zh: 他的剑尖点在你的护甲上
lines.en: The point taps your armour.
The circle bursts at your feet.

lines.zh: 冲击把你掀得退了几步
lines.en: The blast throws you back several steps.
He strikes and returns to his spot.
He recovers, point down.
He points at the ground.
A second circle lights.
Two cuts, two different lines.

lines.zh: 他的动作不急，却很难躲
lines.en: Slow, and hard to avoid.
He keeps chanting as he withdraws.
A red circle surfaces on the ground.
The Sorcerer steps out of it.
Smoke still clings to his robe.
He draws his hood lower.

lines.zh: 黑剑在他手里转了一下
lines.en: The dark blade turns once in his grip.
He stands and looks about.

lines.zh: 红圈在他脚边慢慢熄灭
lines.en: The circle fades at his feet.
The smell of scorch spreads.
He rests the point on the ground.
Then he turns to you.
A red point lights in the distance.

lines.zh: 红点靠近，成了地上的圆
lines.en: It nears and becomes a circle on the ground.
He rises from the circle's centre.
Sparks still cling to his hem.
He draws the blade up from the ground.
A dull red runs down the blade.

lines.zh: 他抬头，兜帽下有两团光
lines.en: He lifts his head; two points glow under the hood.
He extends a finger and points at you.
The circle settles under him.
The wind brings the scorch to you.

lines.zh: 火焰烧到袍角，他抖手扑灭
lines.en: Fire catches his hem; he beats it out.

lines.zh: 落地时他单膝一抵就站起
lines.en: He lands, checks on one knee, and rises.
Water closes over him and the chanting stops.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开他的袍子，人被推开
lines.en: The blast tears his robe and throws him back.

lines.zh: 箭被他用剑拨开，还是划破了手臂
lines.en: He parries the arrow, but it still cuts his arm.

lines.zh: 怪力撞上他的护符，闪出火花
lines.en: Odd force meets his charm and throws sparks.

lines.zh: 久未进食，他的手开始抖
lines.en: Long unfed, his hands begin to shake.

lines.zh: 雷击顺着剑身下来，他咬牙扛住
lines.en: Lightning runs down the blade; he endures it.

lines.zh: 虚空扯他的袍角，他往下沉
lines.en: The void takes his hem and drags him down.
